title: Which sent more into space: one year, or the whole space age?
subtitle: Tap the bigger of three space-age pairs, then watch sixty flat years of launches shoot up, and meet the one project behind most of it.
shape: 5 (duel) + 6 (no up-front guess: b reacts at the reveal and jokes at each twist; b closes)
notes: Brief's claim (2023 > all of 1957–2000) fails on OWID: 2025 = 4,510 vs 5,408 for 1957–2000, so the second pair is a deliberate 'lower'. Compare cards came out small at engine size (auto); size 1.7 + y 500 used so they read. Pairs cannot reuse one item (the shared card is drawn once, its partner row breaks), so '2025 alone' is two items. A region needs two curves, so the since-2020 band is a data polygon. Single-series end label 'Objects' cannot be removed. Review round: winners glow after the answer; cumulative twist drawn as the shaded 1957–2000 area vs a 2025 column; Starlink/64 % beside the since-2020 band; series name 'Launches' (a blank name renders 'Series 1').
